about: Golden moments (R-303): Denning labels each by hand on Model > Golden moments; the engine's reading of the same moment must match before a rebuild is accepted (tools/golden/golden.py score). The engine's own reading is never stored here. `sealed` holds his optional view of what the team should have done, encoded so it is not read by accident: never decode or print it in a chat.

1.name: Flag decision
1.question: The enemy sends a runner, a boost is coming, or the team has its own flag in hand: who runs, and where does everyone else go?

options: an enemy player leaves to run a flag
the enemy's boost is 30 s away
an own player picks up a fresh flag

call.q: Runners (players on flag duty 20 to 30 s later)

options: push the flag through as a team
push the flag through as a team

2.name: Answer to a split
2.question: An enemy group leaves its main and turns out to be a split: how is it answered?

scenario.q: Who is home when they leave?

call.q: The answer (who is home or on the way 30 s later)

3.name: Numbers advantage
3.question: Numbers differ where the main groups meet: what does the deciding team do with it (up), or about it (down)?

scenario.q: Is the deciding team up or down?
Why is the short side short?

became: a retreat (home, nobody to defend against)

moments.trigger: hook's 8 Monk leaves the base at 7:05
Book's boost is 30 s away (it lands at 22:34); Apes's Warrior 2 picks up a fresh flag at the spawn

label.notes: This was a desperation split out the front door with a high DP team late in the game without many other options. The flag pick-up was not a serious attempt to capture flag, he dropped it after and never capped. But there was a decision on whether to cap and what the team should do.

moments.trigger: ohno's Air Ele picks up a fresh flag at the spawn

label.notes:
The decision to run was actually at around 11:42. There is a description of the game up to that point below. 

From ohno's perspective, the game opens with a 3v4 in the backdoor. ohno's warrior collapses through mid to make it a 4v4 and they manage to push xxx back to their footies briefly. The fight turns and ohno retreats to their backdoor footies. ohno's mesmer collapses through mid to make it a 5v4. xxx retreats to backdoor footies and their prot arrives through pit to make it a 5v5. ohno's mesmer returns to mainteam through mid whilst xxx's prot returns to mainteam through pit/frontdoor. 

4v4 is relatively even, though ohno seems to get pushed back. At 6:50, ohno's derv joins split through pit/backdoor but xxx's prot matches on time through mid for 5v5 again. Around 7:40, ohno switches the composition of the 4v4 split and sends mesmer over air ele, where air ele now takes over flag duty. He initiates a double run with the derv of ohno, waiting back for second flag at 7:55. At 8:27, he drops the flag to the derv (both players are halfrunning) and goes to pick up another flag. Air ele then full runs the flag while mainteam pushes towards enemy footies. xxx's mesmer collapses split through mid so ohno has a powerplay at main with the flag capped. Enemy derv starts to run flag at 10:03. Air ele responds almost instantly and goes back to run flag whilst mainteam pushes the pit 3v4 then 3v3. Enemy caps at 10:39 and our air ele overcaps at 10:59. mainteam is stuck in a 3v4 in their pit once running enemy derv returns to base. Air ele follows now that flag is capped towards mainteam and takes outside archer. 

Enemy mesmer takes flag up a bit to drop it to enemy derev, who starts running at 11:21. Air ele waits for 20s pushing the flag and then goes back to run a flag. Air ele caps at 12:54.

moments.trigger: One's Warrior picks up a fresh flag at the spawn

label.notes:
One is stuck in their base with high DP. In a desperation move, they manage to get a flag out on WoC monk. Enemy team collapses but WoC monk manages to escape with shadow of haste. Enemy must now run a flag and sends 8 monk to run, whilst they sit in middle south of flag stand. One responds almost instantly and picks up very very briefly on the warrior before dropping for WoC to run flag. 

Enemy 8 monk caps flag at 18:02 and goes to run a backup whilst team still waits between portals south of flagstand. 8 monk ran over corals both times. At 18:44, enemy leaves there backup flag just over portal (correct play) and is now 8 strong with the flag capped and a backup. Enemy pushes base through portal/backdoor with all 8 at 18:51 leaving space for WoC to finish the flag run.

moments.trigger: Apes's Monk 5 (WoC) leaves the base at 1:37

label.notes: Apes splits three out the backdoor right off the bat. WoC is holding flag, but mainteam sees 5v8 and realises they can't cap the flag (correct play). Mainteam falls back to frontdoor at 0:40 whilst enemy sends two monks (6 and 8) to defend split 2v3. Mainteam is still at a player disadvantage 5v6. Mainteam falls all the way back to pit at 1:37 but has already taken two deaths. WoC runs the flag out backdoor but is met by the enemy WoC and then collapsed on. WoC drops the flag and then dies.

moments.trigger: One's Hammer leaves the base at 9:16; One's Ritualist leaves the base at 9:34

label.notes: Book opens with a solo split through backdoor. One defends with 1 damage (rit). Both teams 7v7 at stand with main/stand mesmers holding flag. 1v1 in split doesn't accomplish anything for 4 minutes and mainteams just 7v7 with no kills and no flag game. Book takes a death on 7 monk at 4:42 so enemy mesmer goes to cap right away. Book is under pressure so mesmer drops flag to warrior and warrior runs to cap (around 5:15 or so). Warrior manages to cap the flag. Book has the flag capped now but is under pressure so no one from one goes to run, they are trying to kill mainteam. Enemy warrior goes to run around 5:55 and our mes/a matches, going back for flag. We push up to their front door to contest flag/push flagger as they are running on a warrior so we are essentially in a power play. Enemy warrior manages to cap whilst enemy mesmer goes back to collapse split. We overcap with mes/a and send back warrior to doublerun. We are now very up on flags so our warrior drops flag to mes/a to hold (we have flag capped and nearly a full flag advantage now). Enemy warrior also went back to run and tries to cap 6v7 by pushing through our team. Warrior caps and we overcap. Neither team sends anyone back to run yet, but enemy mesmer is now coming from split (at 8:20) and picks up a flag to run. Our rit also leaves split and picks up flag. Their mesmer drops flag to warrior to cap. Our flag is coming on rit (8:44). We are not behind on flags but have lost some of our flag advantage time. Our rit halfruns the flag and our warrior picks up the flag to run. Our rit goes out backdoor again to split. Enemy now has the flag capped and our warrior drops the flag to mesmer. Their rit was returning from split and waited in base to halfrun the flag. Enemy rit halfruns the flag to enemy warrior and we are now behind on flags (they have flag capped and our player with flag is around the same distance to flag stand as theirs). We cap, they over cap, and we send back our warrior to doublerun.

moments.trigger: RACK's Mes/A picks up a fresh flag at the spawn; chic's Dervish leaves the main group at 5:53
OG's Air Ele 3 picks up a fresh flag at the spawn
HC's 7 Monk leaves the main group

label.notes:
Both teams start the game running flag short way on their mes/a. hdm's ranger starts game at backdoor and splits to back door through portal right way, defended 1v1 by ranger. HC handoff to stand mes to hold, hdm holds on mes/a. 

At around 1 min, HC goes to collapse hdm's ranger with derv and 8 monk. hdm matches with derv and 8 turning into a 3v3. hdm hands off to stand mes whilst mes/a goes to run (double run). hdm stand mes caps. I'm not sure if HC capped first or if they just have their flag on the ground. HC matches sending their mes/a to run, but HC runs long way back, whilst hdm runs short way back. Both mes/a run shortway towards stand after picking up flag, but hdm has a slight advantage. Meanwhile, hdm ranger was solo splitting, defended by HC ranger. HC collapses derv  and 8 monk, again followed instantly by hdm, turning it into 3v3. 

at around 2 min, hdm split I assume is a bit under pressure so hdm 7 monk pushes to support briefly. This is not really a 4v3 or player advantage, he just cast a couple skills to support the hdm split. HC's 6 monk does similar support at 2:30. HC is still holding flag on Mes/a but hdm hasn't gone to run yet, though they have flag capped. HC's before 2:35, HC's warrior goes to double run and their mes/a caps. HC and hdm's splits both collapse main. 

At 2:50, HC's warrior runs longway, pushed by hdm's ranger and warrior. HC's warrior is supported by 8 monk, and fight converges fully on the flag run. hdm's mes/a is running the next flag shortway. At 3:38, HC's mes/a is flagging and is pushed by hdm's ranger and warrior (supported by 7 monk). HC's 8 monk goes to support mes/a but mes/a dies to death's charge push on warrior. Mes/a base resses and HC's derv goes to run the flag. HC's derv caps whilst mes/a goes back to double run. At 4:40, both rangers solo split the respective enemy bases through backdoor. 

HC's ranger is collapsed by hdm's two mesmers (supported by 7 monk). HC sends prot and derv to support ranger on split. hdm's ranger is undefended and is probably taking NPCs. 

At 5:38, HC's mesmer joins the split and hdm's 7 monk dies to 3 damage. By 7 minutes, hdm's ranger is still undefended and I assume has or is about to clear pit NPCs except lord. hdm's ranger continues solo splitting and is defended by 8 monk until around 11:15 whilst both mainteams fight 7v7. At 11:16, HC looses 4 players in mainteam fight and retreats to base, which also ends up acting like collapse on hdm's ranger with ranger, mesmer, warrior through front door. hdm pushes some of their team frontdoor but hdm's ranger still dies. hdm's ranger base reses, and so does HC's 4 players. hdm is now in a 7v8 in the HC's footies/front door. hdm solo splits mes/a and is defended by mes/a with support from 8 monk. At around 13:40, HC collapses a ranger on hdm's mes/a whilst HC'd mes/a was continuing to defend but ends up disengaging and not following him out backdoor. 

At around 14 min, HC solo splits ranger and hdm defends with mes/a. At 14:35, hdm is doing a similar play, solo spliting ranger defended by HC's mes/a. HC's mes/a defends for a while, but cannot 1v1 hdm's ranger and dies to hdm's ranger around 16:36. hdm responds to this by sending derv also on split through backdoor. hdm also send 8 monk on split before 17:00 and HC collapses 8 monk, derv, mes. HC manages to res their dead mes/a but their stand mes leaves so its a 3v3. split and defense both fall out of HC's base, with hdm's ranger staying on solo split defended by HC's mes/a. 

HC's ranger splits backdoor, supported by HC's prot. hdm defends with derv, mes, 7 monk. HC is 2v3 backdoor, but mainteam 5v4 (HC's mes/a and hdm's ranger are still 1v1 in HC's base). hdm's mes/a then goes to collapse HC's split, leaving hdm 5v3 at mainteam near flag stand. Hc's 7 monk joins split. At 18:40, it looks like hdm's mainteam goes for a full collapse backdoor but is engaged by HC's mainteam. By 19:07, both teams have merged into a 7v7 fight with HC split returning to mainteam.

moments.trigger: Team's Hammer, AoB Derv, Stand Mes, Ritualist leave the main group
hdm's Air Ele, Fire Ele, Ritualist 1, Ritualist 2 leave the main group

label.notes:
hdm starts the match in a 4-4 split. THis is a classic tactic for this type of build. The build is designed to have 2 teams of 4 on opposite sides of the map. Men send 3 out backdoor and initially fall to footies because of the 3v4. Men's rit joins defense through pit and both teams are 4v4 in Men's back footies. Before 1:40, Men swaps rit for prot and defends the 4v4 in their back footies. The split side fight doesn't get any kills, not sure about NPCs or footmen. Men is double running at 4:10 with rit and derv. Before 5:11, Men double runs again on Rit but Rit stays in pit briefly to support the defense before running back to main with a flag. By 6:40, Men's defense has been pushed into their pit (or fell into pit). Before 6:50, Men swaps stand mes for ranger, and defends 4v4 with warrior, mes, prot, and 8 monk. At 7:20, hdm's air ele collapses main through mid. Men responds by sending prot back to main, so split is 3v3. hdm's 7 monk dies mainteam and base reses at 8 min. At 8:15, hdm's mainteam has retreated to their front door footies. At 8:20, hdm's air ele starts going back to split through mid, whilst Men's prot mirrors to join split through front door and pit. 4v4 on split side is maintained until hdm's air ele again collapses through mid, whilst Men's prot again mirrors through front door. Instead of going to main, hdm's air ele solo splits front door followed by Men's prot on defense, whilst hdm's split pulls out backdoor, followed by Men's split team. 

At 10:11, hdm's air ele abandon's the split front door. hdm's air ele pauses in mid for a while, potentially threatening to rejoin split before committing to mainteam whilst Men's prot is out of position.

moments.trigger: 옷옷옷옷's Air Ele, Ritualist leave the main group
ohno's 7 Monk leaves the main group
SKT's Hammer, Ranger, 7 Monk leave the main group

label.notes:
Both teams start the game at stand. Nway has a lyssa derv waiting back for second flag (a double run) right off the start and SKT does not. Nway is at a player disadvantage so caps flag on warrior immediately, to allow lyssa to bring next flag and return to mainteam to mate 8v8. This "waiting back for second flag" is a very common tactic, as is capping first if the other team has all 8 players at main. Nway's derv halfruns the flag to their warrior, and goes back for another flag (double run, half running). Meanwhile, SKT overcapped and sends necro back for second flag. 

For the first minutes of the game, it is just a full mainteam fight around the flag stand, nway's footies, and SKT's footies, until SKT's derv dies and get's based at 4 minutes. It continues to be a mainteam fight with flag runs until nway takes two deaths and then retreats to their pit around 7 minutes. At the 8 minute base res, nway's players res and nway sends a three man split of warrior, mes/a, 8 monk out portal. nway's split pushes in through backdoor and SKT defends 3v3 with warrior, ranger, and 7 monk at around 8:50. both teams maintain this position (nway potentially fighting for NPCs) until nway falls out back door around 9:20. nway's same split stays backdoor and splits offensively into SKT's base through backdoor again around 10:20. SKT defends in their pit with the same composition 3v3 at around 10:55. At 11:30, nway's split falls out backdoor and collapses main, trying to get a numbers advantage before SKT's defenders can reach mainteam through front door. Fight continues 8v8 main until around 12:15 where nway sends the same split. nway does not push backdoor and instead is defended by warrior, necro, and 7 monk of SKT. nway retreats to their own backdoor and now SKT has the 3v3 offensive split at around 12:32. Both 3 man teams "posture" in nway's back door at bridge without engaging, whilst SKT's mainteam pushes front door to nway's base, and nway retreats to pit. At around 13:48, nway's split pushes out backdoor and engages SKT's split. SKT's mainteam moves towards collapsing and nway's split at around 14:22 retreats to their backdoor bridge. 

From around 14:35 to 15:25, nway's 3 man team waits in their backdoor threatening a split, whilst SKT's 3 man matches them and waits outside their front door ready to defend or to split offensively. MEanwhile, SKT's mainteam is pushing the front door of Nway, who has fallen back to their base.
